findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ask_about_levered" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: about_levered, free_analysis · Public sink: free_analysis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: about_levered, free_analysis · Public sink: free_analysis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "about_levered" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
